prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A good starting point is **Business Needs Craftsmanship**. The BBB lists it as an **accredited A+ business** serving Joplin, with services including kitchen and bathroom remodeling, home additions, basement work, and repairs. Call **(816) 599-1292**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/business-needs-craftsmanship-0734-1000011969)

For a broader general-contractor option, **American Construction Inc.** is listed in Joplin and handles residential remodeling and construction. Call **(417) 781-6811**. [Business listing](https://www.yellowpages.com/joplin-mo/mip/american-construction-552117063)

These are leads, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least two written bids, ask for recent references and proof of insurance, and agree in writing on the scope, schedule, payment milestones, and who handles permits.
